title: Test relative FOSB expression in secretory endometrium across fertility strata
question: Is the average within-fertility case minus control difference in relative FOSB expression positive?
scope: Thirty-six whole endometrium single-channel arrays from the New Delhi cohort. Equal stratum weighting and a common reference feature set.
steps: Freeze the phenotype, probe, relative-expression definition and uncertainty calculation before outcomes.
Validate all group fields, the unique target and the common feature set.
Compute and independently verify aggregate estimates.
deliverables: Prospective plan, runnable analysis, regression coverage and aggregate results or a documented blocker.
acceptance: Preserve all four source groups with nine arrays each.
Make the source-name discrepancy, public units and source-design assumptions explicit.
Report the frozen result with its interval, two-sided p-value and leave-one-array-out range.
